line.text: Shio stands at your sink, elbow-deep in the cabinet under it, tools laid out on a towel.
Your cabinet door has been misaligned for at least six days. The hinge screws are stripped.
I notice everything. It's a professional deformation. Anyway. I had the correct screws in my tool kit.
She tightens the final screw with two quick turns of the wrist, then wipes the cabinet door clean.
There. Structurally adequate now. The door should hold until the building is condemned.
You didn't have to do that.
I was already here. It was inefficient to leave it. And you fixed my bathroom lock last month. Reciprocity.
The apartment settles into quiet. She doesn't move toward the door.
I've been sleeping less. Not the case. Just- the quiet here is different from my place.

choice.prompt: She's still standing by the sink. What do you do?

options.text: You can sleep here if you want. The couch is yours.

reaction.text: Nya- that's- I wasn't asking for-
Her tail wraps around her own ankle. She doesn't say no.

options.text: I noticed you've been tired lately.

reaction.text: You remembered that. You didn't have to.
I have a hearing next week. Court prep. It's administratively draining, not- anything else.

options.text: I could stay up with you. If you want company.

reaction.text: I don't think that's a good use of either of our time.
She steps back toward the counter, putting the sink between you.

options.text: Your ears are doing that thing again.

reaction.text: They are not doing a thing. They are ears. They have a physiological response to ambient noise.
She pushes her glasses up even though they haven't slipped.

desc: She quietly fixes something in your apartment and pretends she didn't.
